#!/bin/bash

# =============================================================
# System Diagnostics Collection Script
# Logs CPU usage, memory state, and disk health status
# =============================================================

OUTPUT_DIR="./workspace/diagnostics_output"
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
LOG_FILE="$OUTPUT_DIR/diagnostics_$TIMESTAMP.log"

mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR"

echo "=============================================" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
echo " System Diagnostics Report" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
echo " Generated: $(date)" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
echo "=============================================" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"

# --- CPU Usage ---
echo -e "\n[CPU USAGE]" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
top -bn1 | grep "Cpu(s)" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
echo "Load Average: $(uptime | awk -F'load average:' '{print $2}')" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"

# --- Memory State ---
echo -e "\n[MEMORY STATE]" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
free -h | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"

# --- Disk Health Status ---
echo -e "\n[DISK HEALTH STATUS]" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
df -h | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"

echo -e "\n=============================================" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
echo " Diagnostics saved to: $LOG_FILE" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
echo "=============================================" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
</tool_response>
